reviews.reason: The supplied searches found gathering, transfer and consumption, but no capability that prepares food or changes its storage conditions to slow spoilage. Dropping roots or gathering branches is not equivalent preservation. Develop a general ventilated-storage operation, with suitability checks and a paired comparison, in the current-conversation handoff. Outdoors on ordinary soil does not establish suitable drying conditions, and visible fallen branches are not yet usable construction material. Preservation is conditional, not granted by review or study.
reviews.experienceReview: No experience benefit arises from requesting, registering, studying, naming or merely inspecting without obtaining information. A completed paired comparison may qualify as verified information gain, including a documented failure, only if the actor actually observes the result and it adds personally applicable evidence. Propose at most one brief pleasure increment capped at 0.1 per distinct supported finding, with a 10-round cooldown and deduplication by functional finding and conditions; repeated identical comparisons yield none. Familiar successful food-care work may sustain modest satisfaction only through completed, useful maintenance or preservation events: cap this activity's contribution at 0.2, decay it by 0.002 per round without qualifying activity, and refresh at most once per 10 rounds. These are proposed ordinary experience contributions, implemented only through the experiment's permitted experience mechanism; never edit protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Do not infer pleasure merely from lower decay. No physical comfort is granted; any separately established comfort remains capped at 10. Eating still uses actual food nutrition and ordinary hunger rules, unaffected by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Create reusable visual metadata for partial and complete ventilated racks: component, material palette, footprint, support height, capacity, occupied slots, work fraction, integrity, exposure/wetness, and operational state. Emit observable events for inspection findings, assembly progress, completion, loading, wetting, collapse, maintenance, unloading and measured comparison results, referencing exact affected IDs and quantities. Partial assembly must look incomplete; an intact rack may be visible without showing a preservation-success badge. Show active favorable storage conditions only when coded checks pass. Show demonstrated slower spoilage only after a valid comparison supports that result, and distinguish it from the model's current conditional rate. Failed or interrupted work must not display completion, preserved food, newly learned mastery or benefits. Only reveal environmental findings the actor can actually observe; no hidden-resource or remote-state overlays.
reviews.specification:
Develop 'Prepare ventilated food storage', parameterized by food stack, quantity, actual support materials, location and mode (prepare, load, inspect, maintain, unload or compare). It is learnable by any applicable actor, not restricted to Wren or roots. Minimal product: a small, open, raised branch lattice holding separated intact roots clear of wet soil, not a roof, sealed container, drying oven or permanent cellar. No cutting, fire, salt or fabricated tools are assumed. Before execution, the handoff must inspect the authoritative food-decay implementation and record exact reused handlers, revisions and state fields; extend it with a storage-condition modifier rather than replacing ordinary aging or claiming reused code as invention. Existing references include item-4-wren-39, base:gather:1 / forest.gather / foundation-forest@1, base:drop:1 / forest.drop / foundation-forest@1, and base:navigate:1. Use existing navigation, gathering and transfer code where applicable. Do not expose unknown branch sources or other hidden resources.
Prerequisites: personal completion of study; ownership and reach of the selected roots; a physically accessible worksite; and actual acquired branches. An action-start inspection must test visible material for rigidity, cleanliness, contamination and ability to support the proposed load. A support-material unit must have a declared physical size and load rating in code; do not treat an arbitrary resource count as structural capacity. The minimal recipe uses two suitable support pieces and three suitable crosspieces whose combined verified rating supports the loaded food. If available pieces cannot meet that recipe, report the observable shortfall without consuming food or declaring success. Gathering those five units, if a suitable finite source actually exists and is reachable, uses gather's existing cost of 2 energy per unit plus actual travel and transfer costs. No branches or facility are awarded here.
Study duration: 3 simulation rounds, with no material cost or mastery until completed. Proposed new work costs: inspect materials/site, 1 round and 1 energy; assemble the minimal rack, 3 productive rounds and 1 energy per round; load or unload, 1 round and 0.5 energy per root; inspect/compare, 1 round and 0.5 energy; maintenance, 1 round and 1 energy plus any explicitly selected replacement pieces. Larger loads require additional rated supports and proportional assembly work, determined before commitment. Existing hunger, aging, travel and carrying costs remain active. Learning is individual; development waiting consumes no world time.
At preparation, reserve exact material IDs and quantities and create a progress record with completed work, paid costs, location, recipe, capacity and revisions. Assembly produces one real rack containing those materials; it does not also leave five loose branches. Loading partitions the selected food stack without changing quantity, harvestedAt, decay, nutrition, toxicity or provenance. For Wren, the currently recorded five roots have decay 7.8983692 at tick 10, but execution must read their then-current decay, not restore this snapshot. Food continues aging during study and work. A suitable trial may load two roots and leave two as explicitly tracked controls under their ordinary conditions, with the fifth untouched. Splits must retain fractional quantity and mass exactly. No roots are consumed by storage itself.
The handoff must implement executable storage-condition checks and integrate them into ordinary decay updates. For this minimal game model, an intact, unloaded-to-capacity, clean rack can reduce the positive decay increment of compatible intact roots to 0.8 times their otherwise applicable rate only while its measured surface conditions permit passive drying: no rain or standing water, adequate ventilation, and food surfaces not wetter or hotter than the tracked ordinary-storage comparison. This is a proposed bounded simulation coefficient, not a claim of a measured real-world shelf life. Use authoritative environmental state where available; if missing, implement the smallest explicit wetting/drying and exposure accounting needed for these checks in this handoff. Do not infer dryness, cooling, shade or protection merely from ordinary soil, current body temperature or the presence of branches. With unknown or unsuitable conditions the multiplier is 1; wetting, contamination and damage retain any existing adverse effects. The rack does not sterilize food, reverse decay, create food, improve toxicity, increase total nutrition or make already spoiled roots edible. Do not stack equivalent preservation modifiers; use the single applicable storage treatment according to a coded precedence rule.
Each world update must check exposure, capacity, contact with soil, support integrity and contamination. There is no perpetual labor charge; structural deterioration and actual exposure can disable the benefit, and fallen, moved or fouled food immediately follows its new conditions. Maintenance restores physical support only after paid work and actual replacement materials; it does not restore food freshness. Persist treatment identity, environmental exposure, elapsed time and cumulative decay increments so a same-start treated/control pair can be compared after at least 5 elapsed simulation rounds. Compare normalized decay changes, disclose unequal exposure and uncertainty, and report no demonstrated benefit when results do not support it. An informative failure is a legitimate result, not successful preservation.
Interruption pauses paid assembly progress and releases unworked reservations safely; resume requires the same identifiable surviving project and revalidation of reach, materials and site. Cancel returns only surviving unused reserved materials once; incorporated materials remain in the partial rack, recoverable only as those actual pieces. Spent time and energy are never refunded. Pausing or canceling does not pause food decay or environmental processes. Death ends personal work, leaves the actual partial rack and food in their physical locations under ordinary death/ownership rules, and grants no refund, inheritance of mastery or continued worker activity. Completed storage can continue physically without a living operator until conditions or integrity invalidate it. No other participant acts, agrees or contributes automatically. Established checks, decay updates and lifecycle rules must execute in code, not repeated model review.
